units.text: The 2012 Statistical Abstract of the United States was not published because the U.S. Census Bureau terminated the Statistical Compendia program effective October 1, 2011.

units.text: Since no 2012 edition of the Statistical Abstract exists, the claim that most U.S. state high points exceeded 1,000 feet in that publication is false.
